statements.sql:
SELECT users.id, users.email, users.full_name, users.city, users.country, users.status 
FROM users 
WHERE (users.full_name ILIKE '%' || $1::VARCHAR || '%' ESCAPE '/') AND lower(users.city) = $2::VARCHAR AND users.status = $3 ORDER BY users.id 
 LIMIT $4::INTEGER

SELECT users.id 
FROM users 
WHERE users.id = $1::BIGINT

SELECT orders.id, orders.user_id, orders.status, orders.total_amount, orders.created_at 
FROM orders 
WHERE orders.user_id = $1::BIGINT ORDER BY orders.created_at DESC, orders.id DESC 
 LIMIT $2::INTEGER

SELECT order_items.order_id, order_items.id 
FROM order_items 
WHERE order_items.order_id IN ($1::BIGINT, $2::BIGINT, $3::BIGINT, $4::BIGINT, $5::BIGINT, $6::BIGINT, $7::BIGINT, $8::BIGINT, $9::BIGINT, $10::BIGINT, $11::BIGINT, $12::BIGINT, $13::BIGINT, $14::BIGINT, $15::BIGINT, $16::BIGINT, $17::BIGINT, $18::BIGINT, $19::BIGINT, $20::BIGINT, $21::BIGINT)

SELECT orders.id, orders.user_id, orders.status, orders.total_amount, orders.created_at 
FROM orders 
WHERE orders.created_at >= $1::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE AND orders.created_at < $2::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE AND orders.status = $3 ORDER BY orders.created_at DESC, orders.id DESC 
 LIMIT $4::INTEGER OFFSET $5::INTEGER

Plans.Index Cond: (((status)::text = 'delivered'::text) AND (created_at >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (created_at < '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone))

SELECT orders.id, orders.user_id, orders.status, orders.total_amount, orders.created_at, orders.updated_at, payments_1.id AS id_1, payments_1.order_id, payments_1.status AS status_1, payments_1.amount, payments_1.paid_at, payments_1.created_at AS created_at_1 
FROM orders LEFT OUTER JOIN payments AS payments_1 ON orders.id = payments_1.order_id 
WHERE orders.id = $1::BIGINT

SELECT order_items.order_id, order_items.id, order_items.product_id, order_items.quantity, order_items.unit_price 
FROM order_items 
WHERE order_items.order_id IN ($1::BIGINT)

SELECT CAST(date_trunc($1::VARCHAR, orders.created_at) AS DATE) AS period, count(*) AS order_count, sum(orders.total_amount) AS revenue 
FROM orders 
WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') AND orders.created_at >= $2::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE AND orders.created_at < $3::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc($1::VARCHAR, orders.created_at) AS DATE) ORDER BY period

Plans.Index Cond: ((created_at >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (created_at < '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone))

SELECT anon_1.product_id, products.name, anon_1.units_sold, anon_1.revenue 
FROM (SELECT order_items.product_id AS product_id, sum(order_items.quantity) AS units_sold, sum(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price) AS revenue 
FROM order_items JOIN orders ON orders.id = order_items.order_id 
WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') AND orders.created_at >= $1::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE AND orders.created_at < $2::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE GROUP BY order_items.product_id ORDER BY units_sold DESC, revenue DESC, order_items.product_id 
 LIMIT $3::INTEGER) AS anon_1 JOIN products ON products.id = anon_1.product_id ORDER BY anon_1.units_sold DESC, anon_1.revenue DESC, anon_1.product_id

Plans.Filter: ((created_at >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (created_at < '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND ((status)::text = ANY ('{paid,shipped,delivered}'::text[])))

SELECT (SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM users) AS total_customers, count(*) AS customers_with_orders, count(*) FILTER (WHERE anon_1.order_count > $1::INTEGER) AS repeat_customers, coalesce(sum(anon_1.order_count), $2::INTEGER) AS order_count, coalesce(sum(anon_1.revenue), $3::INTEGER) AS revenue 
FROM (SELECT count(*) AS order_count, sum(orders.total_amount) AS revenue 
FROM orders 
WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') AND orders.created_at >= $4::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE AND orders.created_at < $5::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE GROUP BY orders.user_id) AS anon_1

Plans.Index Cond: ((created_at >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (created_at < '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone))
